items.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Stock Looks Reasonable As Its 125% 3 Year Run Continues
items.summary: Wells Fargo shares have climbed strongly over the past few years, which puts the focus on a simple question for anyone looking at the stock today: Is the current price still aligned with the returns the bank earns on the capital it deploys? Over the past 3 years the stock has returned 124.6%, which puts real weight on whether the business is generating enough return on its capital base to back up that kind of move. items.title: Netflix (NFLX) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of streaming video giant Netflix (NASDAQ: NFLX) fell 5% in the afternoon session after Wells Fargo analyst Steven Cahall downgraded the stock from Equal Weight to Underweight and lowered his price target to $57 from $80. According to TipRanks, Cahall cited user engagement trends and a weaker second-half 2026 original-content slate as primary reasons for the rating change.
